$comment: SOURCE OF TRUTH for DEXI-10 flight-controller parameters. The .params files in dexi-10/ are GENERATED from this file by tools/gen-params.mjs. Never hand-edit them. DEXI-10 is a Pixhawk 6X and shares NO blocks with DEXI-3 (different board, different serial ports, and a DEXI-3 tune on a 10-inch airframe is a crash).
name: DEXI-10

boardDefaults.$comment: Params true of every DEXI-10 with this board and this wiring.

ports.doc: Serial port assignment for the Pixhawk 6X. REQUIRES this wiring: dexi-gps on the GPS2 port, CRSF receiver on TELEM3. Both are 6-pin JST-GH so the cables simply trade places. The dexi-gps CANNOT go on TELEM3: v6X TELEM pins 4/5 are CTS/RTS, not SCL/SDA, so its IST8310 compass is electrically unreachable there. Verified on hardware 2026-08-07.

params.name: GPS_1_CONFIG
params.note: GPS driver on the GPS2 port (/dev/ttyS7). This is the PRIMARY instance on the GPS2 port, so it is GPS_1_CONFIG=202, never GPS_2_CONFIG. A secondary instance never reaches the EKF.

params.name: RC_CRSF_PRT_CFG
params.note: CRSF receiver on TELEM3 (/dev/ttyS1). CRSF needs only TX/RX so a UART-only port suits it, which frees GPS2 for the GPS. NEVER set this to 0 on DEXI-10: unlike DEXI-3, this build has no rc_input driver, so crsf_rc is the only receiver driver present and 0 would disable RC entirely.

external-compass.doc: External magnetometer on the dexi-gps daughterboard (IST8310, I2C 0x0E, reached over the GPS2 port's I2C lines). Do NOT hardcode CAL_MAGn_ROT here: rotation is detected per-airframe by QGC compass calibration. On the first validated build it came out ROTATION_NONE with the orientation triangle to the nose and the cable out the tail.

params.name: EKF2_MAG_TYPE
params.note: Auto. The external mag on the GPS mast is clean enough outdoors.

params.name: SENS_MAG_AUTOROT
params.note: Let compass calibration detect and write CAL_MAGn_ROT. Keep this on so a new board self-detects rather than inheriting another airframe's answer.

params.name: SENS_EXT_I2C_PRB
params.note: Probe external I2C buses, which is how the IST8310 is found at all.

params.name: UAVCAN_SUB_MAG
params.note: No DroneCAN compass is fitted. Leaving this on lets a stale DroneCAN calibration slot masquerade as an enabled compass, which is what produced 'Found 0 compass (required: 1)' on 2026-08-07. Re-enable only if a DroneCAN compass is actually refitted.

outdoor-gps-nav.doc: GPS + external compass outdoor navigation. FLIGHT-VALIDATED 2026-08-09.

params.name: EKF2_GPS_CTRL
params.note: Fuse GPS horizontal position, altitude and 3D velocity.

params.name: EKF2_HGT_REF
params.note: GPS as the primary height reference.

params.name: EKF2_BARO_CTRL
params.note: Keep baro fused alongside GPS height.

params.name: EKF2_GPS_CHECK
params.note: All pre-flight GNSS quality checks on. Worth keeping strict while a new GPS board is under evaluation. If Position mode will not engage, read estimator_gps_status to see WHICH check fails rather than lowering the bar; a failing max_pdop with everything else passing means poor sky view, not a bad param.

first-flight-limits.doc: Conservative envelope for evaluating new hardware. NOT part of the 2026-08-09 validated flight, which flew at stock limits. Layer this on deliberately.

params.name: COM_ARM_WO_GPS
params.note: Refuse to arm without a GPS fix, so you cannot test-fly without the sensor under test. Also blocks bench arming.

params.name: MPC_XY_VEL_MAX
params.note: Down from the stock 12 m/s while a new GPS board is being evaluated.

profiles.name: DEXI-10 Outdoor (GPS)
profiles.description: GPS + external-compass outdoor flight for the DEXI-10 on a Pixhawk 6X, using the dexi-gps daughterboard. Flight-validated 2026-08-09. Requires the dexi-gps on GPS2 and the CRSF receiver on TELEM3.
details: Ports: GPS on GPS2 (GPS_1_CONFIG = 202), CRSF receiver on TELEM3 (RC_CRSF_PRT_CFG = 103)
Heading: external IST8310 on the dexi-gps board (EKF2_MAG_TYPE = 0)
Indoor aiding off: optical flow, external vision and range all disabled
Run QGC compass calibration after fitting the board; rotation is detected, not hardcoded
Does NOT set a flight tune or an RC map. The 4019 airframe supplies the tune.

profiles.name: DEXI-10 First-Flight Limits (optional overlay)
profiles.description: Conservative envelope for evaluating new hardware: 5 m/s cap, a 50 m by 30 m geofence, return on RC loss, and refusing to arm without GPS. NOT part of the validated 2026-08-09 flight, which flew at stock limits. Layer on top of the outdoor-gps profile when trialling something new.
details: Additive: sets only the params listed, on top of your current config
COM_ARM_WO_GPS = 0 also blocks bench arming, so remove it for indoor work
Not flight-validated as a set; each value is a deliberate reduction from stock
